content: In this section, we first introduce the architecture of TCEN, which consists of two encoders connected in tandem, and one decoder with an attention module. Then we give the pre-training and fine-tuning strategy for TCEN. Finally, we propose our solutions for semantic and length inconsistency problems, which are caused by multi-task learning.
